chapter: New York, Dallas and Kansas City
title: Joining Ernie Fields: Philadelphia, Chicago, Oklahoma
summary: Moore left with Ernie Fields's band, playing a week in Chicago before Oklahoma.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: About his ankle. Okay, Ernie Fields came through and he offered you a job and you went.
Yes, we hit Philadelphia and we came to Chicago and I ended up in Oklahoma.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

So you played in Chicago. What happened there? What other places besides what you mentioned -- what other places did you play in Chicago and what musicians did you see perform, you know, did you go around to see other musicians?
No, we were going so fast, we played Chicago only for a week, the theater, and we left right away.
